exposure: Vaginal delivery vs. C-section with GA
Vaginal delivery vs. C-section with RA
finding: The incidence of autism was higher in neonates delivered by C-section with general anesthesia than in neonates delivered vaginally.
mod_finding: The adjusted risk of autism in neonates delivered by C-section with regional anesthesia and in neonates delivered vaginally was nonsignificantly different.
